image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja). The image focuses on the bird's head, neck, and upper chest. Key features include the distinctive long, flat, spatulate bill which is pale pinkish-grey with darker speckling. The face has black, unfeathered skin around the eye and base of the bill. The plumage is predominantly white on the neck and chest, transitioning to vibrant pink feathers on the shoulder/wing area. A crest of pink feathers is visible on the nape. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green bokeh, suggesting foliage.
